description.en: The host-side plugin of the DSH Harmony native HarmonyOS client: native login through the host token exchange, session APIs and a live channel, task overview, per-device notification levels and web session handoff, with no separate relay or gateway daemon.
description.zh: DSH Harmony 鸿蒙原生客户端的宿主端插件：通过宿主令牌交换完成原生登录，提供会话接口与实时通道、任务概览、按设备设置的通知等级和网页会话定位，无需独立 relay 或常驻网关进程。
